data.name: Altijani
data.gender_notes: Altijani is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Altijani is derived from the Arabic word 'Taj' which means crown or honor, and 'An' meaning one. It is a name that signifies purity and handsomeness, symbolizing the noble and honored status of the one bearing this name in the eyes of Allah. The name Altijani carries the meaning “Pure, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Altijani usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Altijani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Handsome.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altijani total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
